geometry.Sigma: sigma_abs/H when H>0; otherwise retain sigma_abs and H separately
geometry.legacy_r: r=s/H and Sigma=sqrt(3)*abs(r) in adopted convention
geometry.free_decay: s ∝ a^(-3) only when shear propagation sources absent

normalization.total_H_nuclei: n_H includes hydrogen isotopes only if explicitly stated; D counted separately under elemental-nuclei mode
normalization.baryon_count: sum_A A*n_A, unambiguously count each isotope exactly once
normalization.helium_per_total_H: y_He=n_He/n_H; He charge states relative to total n_He or total n_H must specify denominator
normalization.ionized_volume_Q: Q_HII != local x_HII or n_e/n_H unless closure given
normalization.n_e_rest: electron rest-frame proper number density; do not apply Lorentz gamma twice
normalization.n_e_normal: normal-frame density; requires explicit frame map

constants.sigma_T: 6.6524587321e-29 m² (reference, bound to input source in production)

energy.ray_energy: E=-p_a n^a c for normal observer
energy.source_age: integral over birth-time with cohort-dependent E/direction and kappa
energy.case_a_case_b: exclusive operator branches; CaseA transported escape must not double count OTS CaseB

observer.d_tau_nontilted: c*sigma_T*n_e^rest dt normal ray proper time
observer.d_tau_tilted: c*sigma_T*n_e^rest*gamma*(1-beta.e) dt for future-directed ray and normal time
observer.tau_tail: unknown tail -> total tau and total visibility return null
observer.redshift_surface: event time t*(direction,geometry) solves observed redshift; do not replace with fixed coordinate time

applicability.counterfactual_shear: |s/H| around 1e-3..1e-1 must explicitly label COUNTERFACTUAL when applied to CMB constrained free-decay mode
applicability.finite_tilt: separate conditional extension; no inferred solver from BI diagonal rays
